theShift.heading: Tuesday morning, before and after.
theShift.subhead: Same crew of twelve. Same week. One of them is running on receipts and group chats; the other one is running Stroyka.
theShift.beforeBody: Hours in WhatsApp. Receipts in the truck. Budgets in a spreadsheet no one has opened since bid day.
theShift.afterBody: Crew clocks in. Budget moves. Materials approve. You open the phone at 6am and know exactly where Johnson Home stands.

features.heading: Everything your crew needs. Nothing they don't.

0.title: Works without cell service
0.body: Stroyka stores everything locally on each device and syncs automatically when a connection returns. Workers can log time, submit requests, and check tasks at any job site — basement, rural, or underground.

1.title: Built for both sides of the crew
1.body: Bosses get budget tracking, approval workflows, and real-time cost reports. Workers get a focused view of their tasks, time logging, and request submission. Same app, purpose-built for each role.

2.title: Know your numbers before month-end
2.body: Every purchase, timesheet entry, and fuel trip rolls up automatically into a project P&L. See labor costs, material spend, and budget remaining at a glance — updated the moment a worker submits.

3.title: No more "did you approve that?"
3.body: Workers submit material or supply requests from the field. Bosses review and approve with one tap. Approved items auto-log to project costs. Full audit trail, no text message chains.

comparison.heading: Where Stroyka lands.
comparison.subhead: Honest comparison. If you’re a 50+ person GC with a dedicated back-office team, enterprise tools are still the right call. If you’re a 5–25 crew trying to stop texting timesheets, keep reading.

3.label: Export to QuickBooks / Xero
3.note: CSV + PDF now, direct integrations on the roadmap.
